change.summary: Member States must ensure penalties for distance financial service infringements include administrative fines or legal proceedings, or both. This amends Directive 2011/83/EU to strengthen enforcement for consumer financial services.

obligations.text: Include administrative fines or legal proceedings for distance financial service infringements.
obligations.quote: With regard to infringements of the measures adopted pursuant to the provisions referred to in Article 3(1b) applicable to distance contracts for consumer financial services, Member States shall ensure that, when penalties are to be imposed in accordance with Article 21 of Regulation (EU)2017/2394, they include the possibility either to impose fines through administrative procedures or to initiate legal proceedings for the imposition of fines, or both.

reasons: The regulation covers distance contracts for consumer financial services, but you sell furniture, wooden goods, and leather goods.
The obligation is addressed to Member States to set penalty frameworks, not to individual sellers like your shop.
